items.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: imagine them trying to make a record like the ballads record, or the record with Johnny Hartman

ctx.x: Aw yeah. Trane had a system, definitely. But, because he had done all this other work, because he had understood how to play swing, he understood how to play ballads…. Think about guys that have systems now and imagine them trying to make a record like the ballads record, or the record with Johnny Hartman, or the record with Duke Ellington. I mean, of all the guys that have systems now, and there are piles of them, name me the one that you think can actually do that?
Did Miles not go through all that preparation, as well, playing in the big bands, playing swing, playing ballads….
